note: Independent rejudgment against RFC 4271 Sections 9.1.2, 9.1.3 and 9.2: upgrade to ENFORCED. The combined in-process reactor session tests and forked-plugin framed JSON-RPC tests now prove forwardability across both local and forked RIB boundaries, and the ordering fix in RIBManager.checkRouteBestChange executes mirrorToLocRIB() before commitReceivedAdvertise() (on both sameBest and changed-best paths) and removeLocRIB() before removeAdvertise() (on newBest == nil, matching withdrawIfUnheld) without lock-order inversion, ensuring synchronous Routing-Table installation/removal completes before Adj-RIB-Out publication/withdrawal. In-process: TestRFC4271OrdinaryOutputRequiresForwardableRoute (positive + negative) verifies every successful ordinary IPv4 recipient transport write resolves both sampled destination host and emitted wire NEXT_HOP in locrib.Default() under one unchanged Revision() matched against captured history, excludes initially unresolved retained input while advertising an independently resolvable control, withdraws on reachability loss and recovers without another UPDATE; TestRFC4271OrdinaryReplacementRecipientSkipsUnresolvedRoute (negative) proves a distinct replacement recipient Session replays useful control without resurrecting retained unresolved input via AdjRIBInManager.handleStructuredState's OrdinaryReplayOwned guard, then recovers on reachability restoration. Forked: TestRFC4271ForkedRemotePublicationForwardableAtStableRevision (positive), TestRFC4271ForkedProspectiveResolutionExcludesUnforwardableRoutes (negative) and TestRFC4271ForkedRevisionInvalidationWithdrawsOnReachabilityLoss (negative) run real RIBManager with locRIB == nil, remoteRIB, routeinstall.Sink, selectedDispatch and sdk.Plugin over framed JSON-RPC net.Pipe() against a real locrib.RIB and igpcost.Resolve/ResolveProspective, closing remoteRIB.prospectiveDistance, RIBManager.runRemoteMetrics revision invalidation, and synchronous insertLocRIB/removeLocRIB before SelectRoutes. All six discrimination records in rfc/discrimination/rfc4271/RFC4271-9.2-2.json are semantically targeted and verified on current test units. Bounds: forked tests use a test-hosted JSON-RPC engine over real locrib.RIB while production server handlers and reactor.SelectRoutes are covered by in-process reactor and daemon CI tests; Section 9.1.3's non-forwarding local-policy exception and kernel dataplane forwarding acknowledgment remain outside these default-policy witnesses.
